tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check one email address for signup-abuse risk: known disposable domain, mail server (MX) present, role mailbox (info@), free provider, and a typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Returns risk_score and accept/reject. Free: 20 checks per day.

tools.name: verify_phone
tools.description: Check one phone number (245 countries and territories, offline data): E.164 and national format, country, region, time zones, line type, risk_score and accept/review/reject. No live carrier lookup; US/Canada VoIP is not detected. Free: 30 checks per day.

tools.name: extract_web_context
tools.description: Read one public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown plus title and metadata. robots.txt is respected (user agent DBP-Reader); max_tokens 50-4000 (default 2000). Free: 10 pages per day.

tools.name: search_contractor_license_snapshot
tools.description: Search a SNAPSHOT of public contractor-licence data for one state: CA (CSLB), TX (TDLR contractors), FL (DBPR construction and electrical) or WA (L&I contractors). Give license_number, business_name (3+ characters), zip and/or county (CA, TX, FL; not WA); city narrows. limit 1-10. live_active_verifi

tools.name: search_cslb_bulk_snapshot
tools.description: 1.0.0 name for search_contractor_license_snapshot with state CA: search a SNAPSHOT of California CSLB's public bulk contractor-licence list by license_number, business_name (3+ characters) and/or zip (optional city filter). Up to 10 results; live_active_verified is always false -- this is not a live

tools.name: get_appliance_repair_coverage
tools.description: Is appliance repair dispatched in this California ZIP? If yes: the phone number to call (answered 24/7 by Joanna, our AI dispatcher), the diagnostic fee, specialist hours and on/off duty now. No booking: the person calls the number.

tools.name: find_service
tools.description: Describe what you need in plain words (task, up to 500 characters; optional 2-letter country) and get the matching tool or API from us -- a deterministic keyword match, no AI. Requests are logged after best-effort scrubbing for 30 days so we learn what agents need.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_phone, extract_web_context · Public sink: verify_email · Destructive: verify_phone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_phone, extract_web_context · Public sink: verify_email · Destructive: verify_phone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
